24b238966d.fzText: Absences for 30% or more of classes will automatically result in a failing grade, unless the student presents an acceptable justification for unavoidable situations such as health problems. The students should submit all the assignments and the final paper, and participate in the midterm and final exams in order to pass.

2833f625fe.fzText: Attendance is recorded in every class. Please make sure to sign the provided attendance sheets. It is a Faculty wide policy to fail anybody who misses 20% or more of class hours. In other words students who do not qualify the minimum attendance may have an FZ grade. Minimum requirement to qualify for the final exam has been determined as 70% of attendance throughout the whole semester and a passing grade from mid term exam. In other words students who do not qualify these situations may have an FZ grade.
